eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Jackson, OR; at 4:36 PM on AUG 13, 2026 Effective until 4:36 AM AUG 14, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildfire Alert - Jackson County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 3 GO NOW evacuation notice for zone JAC-052-B near foothill blvd north of I5 due to I5 Mile Marker 51 Fire. Monitor local news sources for evacuations and incident information.
